definitions.explanation: The construction or building of a castle or fortress. A key concept in Japanese history, particularly during the Sengoku (Warring States) period.

examples.japanese: {築城|ちくじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{三|さん}{年|ねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took three years to build the castle.

examples.japanese: {豊臣|とよとみ}{秀吉|ひでよし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大坂城|おおさかじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{築城|ちくじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{命|めい}じた→命じる：02309_meijiru⟧。
examples.english: Toyotomi Hideyoshi ordered the construction of Osaka Castle.

examples.english: During the Warring States period, castle construction flourished throughout the country, and defensive technologies advanced.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily a historical term associated with Japanese medieval and early modern history. The art and science of {築城|ちくじょう}⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧ (castle-building techniques) was highly developed in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {築城|ちくじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to build a castle)
- {築城|ちくじょう}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ (castle-building technology)
- {築城|ちくじょう}⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧ (the art of castle construction)
- {築城|ちくじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名手|めいしゅ}→名手：28527_meishu⟧ (master castle builder)
